messages:
anya: Kicked off anchor microbatch for q4b bring-up. Sampling from two seedbanks to hit the long tail and verify dedupe heuristics.

carl: Nice. what split between seedbanks?

anya: 55% A, 45% B. dedupe: fuzzyhash@0.93. sampler command used locally:
```
python infra/samplebank/runner.py --cohorts A,B --p 0.55 --strategy crowd-anchor --window 48h --dedupe fuzzyhash:0.93
```

leo: label ops capacity check? want to avoid blocking the golden refresh.

rachel: queue at 42 atm, ETA ~4.5h. recommend marking anchors soft-priority and enabling overlap-guard routing.

anya: done: added tag `prio:soft` and `label-routing: overlap-guard`. also added `deid_flag` + `orig_source` to payload to reduce re-runs.

labeler-bot: queue-status: 42 pending. flagged microbatch 1788123456 as prio:soft. reacting :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

carl: for the eval hooks we need model metadata in each payload: model_name, model_hash, quant_mode, kernel_profile, seed_cohort. include them so regressions can be sliced.

anya: payload sample (text only): {model_name: q4b-large, model_hash: ab12cd34, quant_mode: q4b-int4, kernel_profile: sparse-opt, seed_cohort: A}. validation check `validate_payload --must-have model_hash,quant_mode,orig_source` added.

leo: I'll run a local smoke with n=300 and tokenization diff checks, then bootstrap CI against the holdout golden. will post metrics (accuracy delta, token-error-rate, p50 latency).

rachel: archival/retention: microbatches kept 90 days by default; golden-linked snapshots get promoted to long-term bucket after vetting.

anya: logging plan to s3: s3://redwood-curation/anchor-microbatches/1788123456/ with fields prompt_id,anchor_id,model_hash,quant_mode,latency_ms,tokens_in,tokens_out,label_id,label_rationale.

carl: running an extra dedupe pass for longform with threshold 0.92 to reduce paraphrase churn. after that I'll mark `ready-for-golden`.

anya: timeline: dedupe ~25m, routing ~5m, validation ~5m. review meeting scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT if batch passes. will update thread if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
